text:
liz: FYI oncall noticed export for tenant 'acme-inc' failed last night; NDJSON missing 'actor_id' fields for ~18% of records. Logged as 503 downstream. Anyone recall recent changes to export sampling or batch window?
nate: I saw the alert. stacktrace points to export-worker v2.3.1 - we rolled canaryed it Wed. Could be a sample merger bug.
arjun: We changed the default 'compact' export mode to drop redundant actor info when sampling enabled. That was in the UI rollout for smaller downloads. Maybe the toggle didn't map correctly for tenants with 'preserve_actor=true'.
maya: Ah, we shipped that toggle behind feature-flag `compact-export-v2` — but the console mapping uses `preserveActor` camelCase. Could be proto<->ui mismatch.
liz: Can someone grep for 'preserve_actor' in the runtime? Also wondering why oncall saw 18% missing, not all—maybe sampling ratio mixed.
sara: I'll pull the bundle logs. Quick check: export-worker env shows FEATURE_COMPACT_EXPORT=1 on canary nodes.
ops-bot: alert: export-worker-2 failed consecutively 3 times for tenant=acme-inc, code=500, reason='null actor id in event'
nate: If it's feature-flag mismatch, we need a migration fix + hotpatch. But also console should surface when exports are globally compacted. UX: add a small badge 'actor info suppressed' on preview and a telemetry event when suppressed count > 0.
arjun: Agreed on UX. For API debate: should suppression be at the routing policy layer (per-tenant) or at export-worker (post-routing)? I'd prefer routing-level because it affects caching/batching decisions and quota accounting.
maya: Routing-level is cleaner but needs admin controls in console and a db migration (policy table). Post-routing is faster fix.
sara: Hotpatch plan: roll exporter fix (respect preserveActor flag), re-run failed bundles, emit retro telemetry: `export.actor_missing_count` and `export.suppressed_mode` (bool). Also add console notice.
liz: Can we do: 1) hotpatch today; 2) backfill affected exports and notify customer; 3) design routing-level toggle for next sprint. Assign owners?
nate: I'll take 1), sara will do backfill & replay; arjun will spec routing-level change for RFC next week; maya puts console badge PR.
maya: :thumbsup: Will add console note & add telemetry pings to the preview endpoint. Quick sketch for PR: show suppressed count per bundle, link to 'why' modal.
deploy-bot: canary rollout: export-worker v2.3.2 -> 3 instances (success)
liz: thanks. recording this in postmortem queue. also add quota check: suppressed exports should still count against customer quota. add that to the RFC.
